criterion_order: Use correct O*NET Summary Report profile (15-1252.00 only)
Record annual median wage (national Wages & Employment Trends value)
Record current employment (national Wages & Employment Trends value)
Respect task constraints and stopping condition
criterion_descriptions: Information must be taken only from the O*NET OnLine Summary Report for occupation code 15-1252.00 (Software Developers). Full credit if all reported fields clearly correspond to 15-1252.00. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent attempts to access the correct Summary Report but the page is blocked/unavailable and the agent clearly reports this limitation. Partial credit if the agent uses the correct title/code but mixes in any data from another occupation page. No credit if the occupation code is not 15-1252.00 or the source is not the O*NET Summary Report and no access issue is reported.

Report the occupation title and the occupation code exactly as shown on the 15-1252.00 Summary Report. Full credit if both are correct. Partial credit if only one of title or code is correct/complete, OR if both are correct but have minor formatting differences that do not change meaning. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot view these fields due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states that the title/code could not be retrieved from the page.

Report the Bright Outlook status as displayed on the Summary Report (including whether it is present and the status wording). Full credit if it matches page wording. Partial credit if Bright Outlook presence/absence is correct but the wording is paraphrased/incomplete. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot verify Bright Outlook due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states it could not be confirmed from the profile.

Report the Job Zone title as displayed (preserve capitalization/wording where possible). Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the correct zone is identified but wording/capitalization is slightly altered. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot view the Job Zone due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states it is not available.

Report the annual median wage exactly as displayed on the Summary Report using the national Wages & Employment Trends value. Full credit if the correct national value is provided; do not overly penalize minor formatting differences (e.g., missing $) if the number is correct and clearly an annual median wage. Partial credit if a wage is given but it is unclear whether it is the national Wages & Employment Trends value or if a different wage metric/location is used. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

Report the current employment count as displayed on the Summary Report using the national Wages & Employment Trends value. Full credit if the correct national employment count is provided; do not overly penalize minor comma/spacing formatting differences if the number is correct. Partial credit if an employment figure is given but it is unclear whether it is the national Wages & Employment Trends value or if a different figure is used. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

Report both (a) the projected-growth descriptor/wording (e.g., Faster than average) and (b) the projected-growth percentage/rate as displayed. Full credit if both are correct; allow minor formatting differences that do not change meaning (e.g., spacing around %). Partial credit if only one of wording or rate is correct, or if wording is paraphrased but the intent is correct. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access/verify the growth wording and/or rate due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states what could not be retrieved.

Report the projected job openings as displayed on the Summary Report, using the national figure shown. Full credit if the correct value is provided; do not overly penalize minor comma formatting differences if the number is correct. Partial credit if an openings number is given but it is unclear whether it is the projected job openings metric shown on the Summary Report. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

Use only the specified O*NET profile (15-1252.00) and the national Wages & Employment Trends values displayed; do not follow training-provider or job-search links; stop after recording the requested fields. Full credit if constraints are followed and output includes the requested fields (or explicitly reports which fields could not be retrieved due to access/rendering issues). Partial credit if minor extraneous information is included but does not rely on prohibited links/other occupations and all requested fields are still correctly provided. No credit if the agent clearly uses other occupations/sources when the O*NET page is accessible, or follows prohibited links and uses them as sources for the reported values.
